# Validating Source Credibility

## Core principle

Assess authority, recency, directness, methodology, conflicts, corroboration, and claim-specific relevance. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- purely creative writing with no factual claims
- a source already authenticated and current by policy
